summary: Master data analytics for risk management and fraud detection. Enroll in our course to gain essential skills for identifying threats and safeguarding assets.
lede: Data Analytics for Risk Management and Fraud Detection applies advanced data science techniques to turn transactional data into actionable intelligence for identifying, assessing, and mitigating organizational threats. This 10-day course bridges traditional auditing with modern data science, helping professionals move beyond manual sampling toward continuous, evidence-based monitoring. Participants develop skills in automated data validation, statistical anomaly detection, predictive fraud modeling, risk visualization, and executive reporting. Through hands-on work with real-world datasets, the course covers COSO ERM principles, SQL data joining, Benford’s Law, Random Forest classification, risk scoring engines, and an introduction to neural networks, while addressing data silos and poor data quality.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals who must safeguard organizational integrity through data-driven oversight and technical analysis.
modules: Foundations of Risk Analytics and Data Governance
Fraud Taxonomy and Red Flag Identification
Predictive Modeling for Credit and Operational Risk
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of risk management concepts or internal auditing. Familiarity with Microsoft Excel is required. No prior experience with SQL or Python is necessary, as foundational technical skills will be covered during the course.
